blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — The Iligan City Traffic and Parking Management Office (ICTPMO) has advised drivers of vehicles coming from Lanao del Norte and Misamis Oriental provinces who have no business in the city proper to use the C3 Road, particularly those driving light vehicles and medium-sized trucks. The advisory aims to ease traffic congestion caused by the ongoing repair of the Tambacan Bridge by the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH). The DPWH has installed billboards and road signs at entry points near the National Steel Corporation in Barangay Suarez, the national highway in Barangay Buruun, Tambo Terminal and Barangay […]...
